info.title: VCam RPC
info.description: The public JSON-RPC 2.0 API of VCam, served over a localhost WebSocket. Methods marked with the `Events` tag are notifications VCam pushes to subscribed clients (`x-direction: serverToClient`); subscribe to them with `events.subscribe`.

methods.name: app.getInfo
methods.summary: Returns the app version, API version, and capabilities

apiVersion.description: The version of this API specification.

appVersion.description: The version of the running VCam app.

capabilities.description: Feature areas this VCam build supports, e.g. "vrma" when VRMA motions are available.

methods.name: state.get
methods.summary: Returns the current avatar, playing motions, expressions, and subtitle

avatarId.description: The last loaded avatar from the avatar library; absent when the current avatar was loaded directly from a file.

subtitle.description: The subtitle text; empty when the subtitle is hidden.

expressions.description: The applied expressions; empty when none is applied.

methods.name: avatar.list
methods.summary: Lists the avatars registered in the avatar library

methods.name: avatar.load
methods.summary: Loads an avatar from the avatar library
methods.description: The response comes when the avatar has loaded and expression.list lists its expressions. avatar.loaded follows the same moment.

methods.name: avatar.import.begin
methods.summary: Starts uploading a VRM file to import into the avatar library
methods.description: Returns an importId and prepares a staging area. Send the file content as WebSocket binary frames on the same connection: each frame is the 36-byte importId (its UUID string as ASCII) followed by a chunk of file data. Frames must not exceed 1 MiB in total. Finish with avatar.import.commit, or abort with avatar.import.cancel. Available only when app.getInfo lists the avatarImport capability.

params.name: filename
params.description: The name of the uploaded file including the .vrm extension. Used as the default display name.

methods.name: avatar.import.commit
methods.summary: Registers the uploaded file to the avatar library
methods.description: Validates the uploaded data as a VRM and registers it to the avatar library. The staging area is removed regardless of the outcome. With `load`, the response comes when the avatar has loaded.

params.name: load
params.description: Loads the imported avatar immediately.

methods.name: avatar.import.cancel
methods.summary: Aborts an upload and removes its staging area

methods.name: expression.list
methods.summary: Lists the expressions of the current avatar

methods.name: expression.set
methods.summary: Sets the expressions on the current avatar
methods.description: The list is the whole face: expressions left out fade to nothing, and an empty list takes every expression off. Expressions mix by their weights, and how well they mix depends on the model. With a duration, the response comes when the fade has ended. With microphone lip sync, the mouth keeps moving under the expressions.

params.name: expressions
params.description: The expressions to wear. Each name may appear once.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds to fade over, up to 60. Omit or pass 0 to change at once.

params.name: easing
params.description: Defaults to easeInOut. VCam2D uses its own curve when changing to another expression.

methods.name: gaze.set
methods.summary: Decides where the avatar looks
methods.description: The eyes get there first and the head follows, so there is no duration to give. The eyes still wander a little, as they do on their own. This stays until set again, across scenes and avatars, and wins over face tracking. A head received over the VMC Protocol wins over this one's head, while the eyes still follow it.

params.name: mode
params.description: `auto` returns to face tracking, or to looking ahead without it. `camera` looks into the camera. `direction` looks by `yaw` and `pitch`.

params.name: yaw
params.description: With `direction`: degrees from straight ahead, from -90 to 90. Positive looks to the right of the screen.

params.name: pitch
params.description: With `direction`: degrees from straight ahead, from -45 to 45. Positive looks up.

params.name: movesHead
params.description: False moves only the eyes. Defaults to true.

methods.name: motion.list
methods.summary: Lists the available motions (built-in and imported)

methods.name: motion.play
methods.summary: Plays a motion

params.name: loop
params.description: Overrides the motion's loop setting for this playback; the stored setting is used when omitted.

params.name: wait
params.description: Responds when the motion has stopped instead of when it has started. A looping motion or a pose never stops by itself, so it responds at once. Defaults to false.

methods.name: motion.stop
methods.summary: Stops a playing motion

methods.name: motion.import.begin
methods.summary: Starts uploading a motion to add to the library
methods.description: Send the file as binary WebSocket frames, each one the 36-byte importId followed by a chunk of at most 1 MiB. Available only when app.getInfo lists the vrma capability.

params.name: filename
params.description: The file name with its extension: vrma, or vmd where the app can convert it.

methods.name: motion.import.commit
methods.summary: Adds the uploaded motion to the library

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the app. Defaults to the file name.

params.name: loop
params.description: Defaults to false.

params.name: isPose
params.description: Holds the pose instead of playing through, while the head, hands and fingers keep following tracking. Defaults to false.

duration.description: Seconds; absent when it can't be told.

methods.name: motion.import.cancel
methods.summary: Aborts a motion upload

methods.name: motion.remove
methods.summary: Removes an imported motion from the library
methods.description: Built-in motions cannot be removed.

methods.name: scene.list
methods.summary: Lists the scenes

methods.name: scene.get
methods.summary: Returns the current scene

methods.name: scene.load
methods.summary: Loads a scene

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds to crossfade from the current frame over, up to 60. Omit or pass 0 to switch at once.

params.name: easing
params.description: Defaults to easeInOut.

methods.description: With a duration, the current frame stays on screen while the scene loads, then fades out over the new scene. The response comes when the crossfade has ended.

methods.name: camera.reset
methods.summary: Resets the avatar and camera to the initial position

methods.name: scene.create
methods.summary: Creates a scene and loads it

methods.name: scene.duplicate
methods.summary: Copies a scene without loading the copy

methods.name: scene.rename
methods.summary: Renames a scene

methods.name: scene.move
methods.summary: Moves a scene to a position in the list

params.name: index
params.description: The position in scene.list after the move.

methods.name: scene.remove
methods.summary: Removes a scene and everything in it
methods.description: The last scene of the current orientation cannot be removed.

methods.name: scene.getLighting
methods.summary: Returns the avatar lighting of the current scene
methods.description: `lighting` is absent while the scene uses the default light. Available only when app.getInfo lists the sceneLighting capability.

methods.name: scene.setLighting
methods.summary: Sets the avatar lighting of the current scene
methods.description: Available only when app.getInfo lists the sceneLighting capability.

params.name: lighting
params.description: Omit to return to the default light.

methods.name: canvas.get
methods.summary: Returns the output size in pixels

methods.name: frame.capture
methods.summary: Returns the current output as an image
methods.description: Requires the user to allow frame capture in the VCam API settings; app.getInfo lists the frameCapture capability while it is allowed.

params.name: maxWidth
params.description: Scales the image down to this width. Defaults to the output width.

params.name: format
params.description: Defaults to jpeg.

methods.name: object.list
methods.summary: Lists the objects of the current scene, from back to front
methods.description: Placements are fractions of the canvas: `x` and `y` are the offset of the object's center from the center of the canvas (`y` grows upward, so -0.5 to 0.5 stays on the canvas), and `width` and `height` are its size. The subtitle is not listed; see subtitle.getStyle.

methods.name: object.update
methods.summary: Changes an object's name, visibility, lock, or placement
methods.description: A locked object rejects every change except unlocking it, so that a layout the user fixed is not changed by accident. With a duration, the placement moves and the visibility fades, the response comes when they have ended, and another change of the same kind takes over from where the object is by then. Text looks scaled during a move and redraws sharply at the end. Wind has nothing to fade, so it changes at once.

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the object list.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds to animate the placement and visibility over, up to 60. Omit or pass 0 to apply them at once.

params.name: easing
params.description: Defaults to easeInOut.

methods.name: object.move
methods.summary: Moves an object to a position in the stacking order

params.name: index
params.description: The position in object.list after the move: 0 is the backmost.

methods.name: object.duplicate
methods.summary: Copies an object in the current scene

methods.name: object.remove
methods.summary: Removes an object from the current scene

methods.name: text.add
methods.summary: Adds a text object to the current scene

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the object list.

params.name: preset
params.description: A preset id from text.listPresets to start from.

params.name: style
params.description: Applied on top of the preset.

methods.name: text.get
methods.summary: Returns the text and style of a text object

methods.name: text.update
methods.summary: Changes the text or style of a text object
methods.description: The edge the alignment anchors stays in place, so the object grows as the text gets longer.

params.name: preset
params.description: A preset id from text.listPresets to apply first.

params.name: style
params.description: Applied on top of the preset.

methods.name: text.listPresets
methods.summary: Lists the text style presets

methods.name: text.listFonts
methods.summary: Lists the PostScript names of the installed fonts

methods.name: subtitle.set
methods.summary: Shows text as the subtitle
methods.description: Replaces the subtitle with the given text. The subtitle keeps the style and placement configured in the app, and is shared by every scene. Passing an empty string is the same as subtitle.clear.

methods.name: subtitle.clear
methods.summary: Hides the subtitle

methods.name: emoji.show
methods.summary: Shows an emoji as a temporary stamp on the frame
methods.description: Available only when app.getInfo lists the emoji capability.

params.name: emoji
params.description: A single emoji.

methods.name: tracking.getState
methods.summary: Returns the connection state of the tracking sources
methods.description: Covers the sources that connect from other apps and devices: `vcamMotion`, `iFacialMocap`, and `vmcProtocol`.

methods.name: subtitle.getStyle
methods.summary: Returns the style and placement of the subtitle

methods.name: subtitle.setStyle
methods.summary: Changes the style and placement of the subtitle
methods.description: Applies to every scene and stays after a restart. With a duration, the response comes when the placement has ended. The subtitle looks scaled during the move and redraws sharply at the end.

params.name: preset
params.description: A preset id from text.listPresets to apply first.

params.name: style
params.description: Applied on top of the preset.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds to animate the placement over, up to 60. Omit or pass 0 to apply it at once. A style changes at once either way.

params.name: easing
params.description: Defaults to easeInOut.

methods.name: image.import.begin
methods.summary: Starts uploading an image to add to the current scene
methods.description: Send the file as binary WebSocket frames, each one the 36-byte importId followed by a chunk of at most 1 MiB.

params.name: filename
params.description: The file name with its extension: png, jpg, jpeg, gif, heic, webp, or tiff.

methods.name: image.import.commit
methods.summary: Adds the uploaded image to the current scene

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the object list.

methods.name: image.import.cancel
methods.summary: Aborts an image upload

methods.name: video.import.begin
methods.summary: Starts uploading a video to add to the current scene
methods.description: Send the file as binary WebSocket frames, each one the 36-byte importId followed by a chunk of at most 1 MiB. A file can be up to 512 MiB.

params.name: filename
params.description: The file name with its extension: mp4, mov, or m4v.

methods.name: video.import.commit
methods.summary: Adds the uploaded video to the current scene and starts playing it

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the object list.

params.name: isLooping
params.description: Whether it starts over at the end. Defaults to true. Otherwise it holds the last frame.

params.name: isMuted
params.description: Defaults to true. Unmuted, the sound goes to the system's default output.

methods.name: video.import.cancel
methods.summary: Aborts a video upload

methods.name: video.get
methods.summary: Returns the playback state of a video object

methods.name: video.update
methods.summary: Plays, pauses or seeks a video object, or changes its options
methods.description: Omitted values stay as they are. Playing a video that has reached its end starts it over. While the object is hidden the video stays paused and continues when it is shown.

params.name: time
params.description: The position to seek to, in seconds.

methods.name: web.add
methods.summary: Adds a web page to the current scene

params.name: url
params.description: An http or https URL.

params.name: name
params.description: The name shown in the object list.

params.name: width
params.description: The page width in pixels. Defaults to 800.

params.name: height
params.description: The page height in pixels. Defaults to 600.

params.name: fps
params.description: How many times per second the page is drawn. Defaults to 6.

methods.name: web.update
methods.summary: Reloads a web page object with new settings
methods.description: Omitted values stay as they are, so passing only objectId reloads the page.

params.name: url
params.description: An http or https URL.

methods.name: camera.adjust
methods.summary: Moves the camera relative to where it is
methods.description: The result is saved in the current scene. With a duration, the response comes when the move has ended, and another camera.adjust takes over from where the camera is by then.

params.name: panX
params.description: As a fraction of the output height; positive moves the avatar right.

params.name: panY
params.description: As a fraction of the output height; positive moves the avatar up.

params.name: orbitX
params.description: Turns around the avatar, in the same units. VCam2D treats this as panning.

params.name: orbitY
params.description: Turns around the avatar, in the same units. VCam2D treats this as panning.

params.name: zoom
params.description: A magnification relative to now, from 0.1 to 10: 2 shows the avatar twice as large, 0.5 half as large.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds to animate the move over, up to 60. Omit or pass 0 to apply it at once.

params.name: easing
params.description: Defaults to easeInOut.

methods.name: pose.open
methods.summary: Opens the pose editor with the current avatar
methods.description: Opens the pose editor window, or fronts it when it is already open, and loads the current avatar into it. The other pose methods require the editor to be open. Bone names follow VRM 1.0 (`hips`, `spine`, `leftUpperArm`, ...); rotations are degrees relative to the rest pose (T-pose), applied in Y, X, Z order around the bone's own axes, so `[0, 0, 0]` is the rest pose. Expressions are named as VRM 1.0 names its presets (`happy`, `blink`, ...) and as the model names its custom expressions; weights run from 0 to 1. Available only when app.getInfo lists the poseEditor capability. Besides rotating bones one by one with pose.set, pose.move pulls a hand, foot, elbow, knee, the head or the hips to a point and solves the limb with IK, the way dragging it in the editor does.

bones.description: The humanoid bones the avatar has, in VRM order.

expressions.description: The expressions the avatar has: presets first, then custom expressions.

movableBones.description: The bones pose.move can pull: the hips, the head, the elbows, the knees, the hands and the feet the avatar has.

methods.name: pose.get
methods.summary: Returns the pose being edited

methods.name: pose.set
methods.summary: Poses bones in the editor
methods.description: Applies the given bones as one undoable change. `position` is accepted for `hips` only.

params.name: joints
params.description: The bones to pose. Bones not listed keep their current pose.

methods.name: pose.move
methods.summary: Pulls bones to points with IK
methods.description: Moves each listed bone to its point and solves the bones between it and the body, as one undoable change: a hand or foot is reached with the arm or leg (the shoulder follows; an unreachable point is approached at full stretch), an elbow or knee is moved while the hand or foot stays as close as it can to where it was, the head is leaned toward the point by bending the spine (the hips stay; only the direction is followed), and the hips are placed as given. The bones are solved in the order listed. Rotations the solver writes replace what pose.set had set on those bones; the result returns the whole pose so the caller can read them.

params.name: joints
params.description: The bones to pull and where to. Bones not listed keep their pose unless the solver bends them.

params.name: plantFeet
params.description: When moving the hips, keep both feet where they are and bend the legs. Defaults to true; false moves the whole body.

result.name: joints
result.description: The pose after solving, as pose.get returns it.

methods.name: pose.reset
methods.summary: Returns bones to the rest pose

params.name: bones
params.description: The bones to reset. Omit to reset every bone.

methods.name: pose.expressions.get
methods.summary: Returns the expression weights being edited

methods.name: pose.expressions.set
methods.summary: Weights expressions in the editor
methods.description: Applies the given weights as one undoable change. Expressions not listed keep their current weight.

params.name: expressions
params.description: The expressions to weight.

methods.name: pose.expressions.reset
methods.summary: Takes expressions off

params.name: names
params.description: The expressions to take off. Omit to take off every expression.

methods.name: pose.apply
methods.summary: Plays the pose on the live avatar
methods.description: Shows the pose on the avatar in the main window as a looping motion, replacing a pose applied earlier. Stop it with motion.stop on the motion ID reported by motion.started, or by closing the editor.

methods.name: pose.export
methods.summary: Returns the pose as a VRM animation
methods.description: Writes the pose as a `.vrma` (VRMC_vrm_animation) clip that holds it for `duration` seconds, with the expressions worn (weight above 0) written into it, and returns the file as base64.

params.name: name
params.description: The animation's name inside the file.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds the clip holds the pose. Defaults to 2.

methods.name: pose.saveAsMotion
methods.summary: Adds the pose to the motion library
methods.description: Registers the pose as an imported motion holding it for `duration` seconds, so motion.play and the toolbar can play it.

params.name: name
params.description: The display name in the motion list.

params.name: duration
params.description: Seconds the clip holds the pose. Defaults to 2.

params.name: loop
params.description: The motion's loop setting. Defaults to false.

methods.name: pose.close
methods.summary: Closes the pose editor

methods.name: events.subscribe
methods.summary: Subscribes this connection to server-pushed events
methods.description: Connections receive no events until they subscribe. Omit `events` to subscribe to all events.

params.name: events
params.description: Event method names to receive, e.g. ["motion.started"]. Omit to receive all events.

methods.name: rpc.discover
methods.summary: Returns the OpenRPC document describing this API

methods.name: avatar.loaded
methods.summary: An avatar has been loaded

params.name: avatarId
params.description: Absent when the avatar was loaded directly from a file instead of the avatar library.

methods.description: Sent when the avatar has finished loading, whatever asked for it.

methods.name: motion.started
methods.summary: A motion has started playing

methods.name: motion.stopped
methods.summary: A motion has stopped playing

methods.name: expression.changed
methods.summary: The applied expressions have changed

params.name: expressions
params.description: The applied expressions; empty when none is applied.

methods.name: scene.loaded
methods.summary: A scene has been loaded

methods.name: subtitle.changed
methods.summary: The subtitle text has changed

methods.name: objects.changed
methods.summary: Objects of the current scene were added, changed, or removed
methods.description: Sent whatever the cause, including edits in the app and switching scenes. Read the new state with object.list.

methods.name: tracking.connected
methods.summary: A tracking source has started sending data

methods.name: tracking.disconnected
methods.summary: A tracking source has stopped sending data

duration.description: Seconds; absent when it can't be told, such as when no avatar is loaded.

status.description: `connecting` means VCam is waiting for the source to send data.

rotation.description: Degrees around the bone's X, Y and Z axes relative to the rest pose, applied in Y, X, Z order.

position.description: The hips' local position in meters. Present for hips only; to move a bone with IK use pose.move instead.

effector.description: Where the bone is in the scene, in meters (x right, y up, z toward the viewer for a VRM 1.0 model). Present only for the bones pose.move can pull; pass a point near it to move the bone there.

name.description: An expression name as expression.list gives it.

weight.description: 0 takes the expression off; 1 wears it in full.

name.description: One of the bones pose.open lists in movableBones.

position.description: The point to pull the bone to, in scene meters (the same space as JointPose.effector).

ObjectPlacementUpdate.description: Omitted values stay as they are. Height follows the width so that the object keeps its aspect ratio.

placement.description: Absent for objects that have no rectangle on the canvas: the avatar and wind.

direction.description: Degrees of a linear gradient: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom.

fontSize.description: The size the text is laid out at, from 8 to 1024. Outlines, shadows and paddings are in the same units. The size on the canvas comes from the placement.

lineHeight.description: A multiplier: 1 is the font's default.

wrapCharacters.description: Wraps lines after this many fullwidth characters. 0 wraps only at explicit line breaks.

outlines.description: The first is the topmost. An empty array removes them.

blur.description: The blur radius. 0 removes the blur.

background.description: A fully transparent color removes the background.

TextStyle.description: Omitted values stay as they are.

x.description: The offset of the center from the center of the canvas, as a fraction of the canvas width.

bottomY.description: The bottom edge, measured upward from the center of the canvas, as a fraction of the canvas height.

size.description: A multiplier of the default size.

SubtitlePlacement.description: Omitted values stay as they are.

azimuth.description: Degrees around the avatar as seen from the background: 0 lights it from the camera's side, negative from the left of the screen, 180 from behind.

elevation.description: Degrees above the horizon: 90 is straight overhead.

shadow.description: From 0 to 1: 0 lights the avatar evenly, 1 leaves the side away from the light unlit.

rim.description: A light from behind that outlines the silhouette. Absent turns it off.

isPlaying.description: False once paused or past the end of a video that does not loop. A hidden object can report true while waiting to be shown.

invalidVrm.message: The uploaded file is not a valid VRM.

unsupportedOperation.message: This operation is not supported by this VCam.

poseEditorNotOpen.message: The pose editor is not open.

boneNotMovable.message: Bone cannot be moved with IK.

objectTypeMismatch.message: This operation does not apply to this type of object.

objectHasNoPlacement.message: This object has no placement on the canvas.

sceneNotRemovable.message: The last scene cannot be removed.

frameCaptureDisabled.message: Frame capture is not allowed in the VCam API settings.

invalidImage.message: The uploaded file is not a valid image.

avatarLoadFailed.message: The avatar could not be loaded.

invalidMotion.message: The uploaded file is not a valid motion.

invalidVideo.message: The uploaded file is not a video that can be played.
